decisions.statement: A midnight written into a template is read as a midnight written with `+`.
The midnight is looked for at the head of the piece following the date.
A midnight further in is text about a time rather than a time being built.
Seconds and a fraction after the midnight are read as the midnight itself.
One instant is named at more length.
Every piece of a joined chain is read.
An hour that is not midnight is left.
The fault is the pretence that a date names an instant rather than the joining itself.
A midnight held in a variable and joined on in a later statement is not seen.

definition: the rule refusing a date turned into an instant by pinning a midnight onto it
